name: computer-use
description: Use the independent MiniCode Windows computer runtime with application approvals and real turn ownership.

interface.longDescription: Control running Windows application windows using MiniCode's independent receiving runtime. Each selected application requires its own approval. This implementation supports screenshots, clicks, text, keyboard and scrolling. Browser APIs, accessibility trees, launching applications and macOS/Linux are not supplied by this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Help me work with an open Windows application.
